## [2.2.0] - 2026-10-10

### Added

- [PLAN-SDP-0023] Explicit SDP/programs.json declarations add runnable SDUI programs alongside existing source discovery. run --program starts the selected connected application with literal arguments, project working directory, revision checks and child exit/cancellation handling.
- [PLAN-SDP-0022] SDUI 0.3 supplies the completed Go/Fyne widget families: collections, scrolling, tabs, split panes, shared commands, dialogs, typed values, extended text and provider-backed previews. Connected applications supply their SDL/Go bindings and providers; generic prototype readiness remains separate.
- [PLAN-SDP-0017] ModelGovernance provides WORK artifacts, local checkpoints/recovery, bounded merge/promotion, accepted snapshots and artifact-aware discovery through sdptool model.

### Changed

- [KB-SDP-042] The managed SDP entrypoint carries the accepted manual Session upkeep guidance. Language, process and management schema versions remain independent of this tool release.

### Migration

- [MAINT-SDP-0015] Update gh-sdp to 0.2.2 for the new default engine. No project SDP-directory upgrade is required for program discovery; projects opt in with SDP/programs.json and retain ownership of their application build/runtime. Use discover before run. XFMD must consume the program contract; updating the extension alone does not change its Run button.
- [MAINT-SDP-0015] Linux amd64 signed distribution supports original SDP 0.2.0, 0.2.1, 1.0.0, 2.0.0 and 2.1.0 predecessors. Framework remains 2.0.0. Existing sources, project programs and owner documents are preserved.
